card.text: WASP-14 b was found in 2008 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-14b"
sources.quote: WASP-14b is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008 by SuperWASP using the transit method.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-14. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-14b"
sources.quote: Follow-up radial velocity measurements showed that the mass of WASP-14b is almost eight times larger than that of Jupiter.

shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.

temperature.summary: Heat at 4.5 µm from the paper's phase-curve fit. It varies only with longitude: the data hold no north-south detail.
